description: Draws a black and white preview of a static QR code for a web address, plain text, email, phone call, text message, WiFi network or contact card. Returns the PNG image and a link that opens the same content in the qrforprint editor, where it can be styled and downloaded as PNG, SVG, PDF or EPS. Nothing is saved and no account is needed. A static code cannot be changed after it is printed.

phone.description: type phone: the number to call, international format such as +14155550123.

smsPhone.description: type sms: the number the text message goes to.

text.description: type text: the plain text to encode.

type.description: What the code holds: url, text, email, phone, sms, wifi or vcard (contact card).

url.description: type url: the web address, starting with http:// or https://.

wifiEncryption.description: type wifi: WPA (default), WEP, or nopass for an open network.

wifiHidden.description: type wifi: true if the network name is hidden.

name: preview_qr_code
title: Preview a QR code
